templates.title: Stations along an open route
templates.description: Place stations every 1 km of WGS84 geodesic distance along an ordered route and require a maximum total length. Replace the CSV path.

source.label: Waypoint CSV source
source.description: Absolute local ASCII CSV with columns lon_deg,lat_deg (optionally name first) in WGS84 decimal degrees, in route order.

templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python with exactly pyproj 3.8.0 and PROJ 9.9.0 (--pyproj) and select a waypoint CSV.

templates.title: Stations around a closed loop
templates.description: Close the route back to its first waypoint (do not repeat it in the CSV) and station it every 2 km.

source.label: Waypoint CSV source
source.description: Absolute local ASCII CSV with columns lon_deg,lat_deg (optionally name first) in WGS84 decimal degrees, in route order.

templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python with exactly pyproj 3.8.0 and PROJ 9.9.0 (--pyproj) and select a waypoint CSV.
